description: Synthetic dialogue profile for the generated 24-frame Black Water replay clip testdata/synthetic/replay/black-water-001 (docs/spec/11 'Fixture origins', ADR-0078). Structurally different from dialogue-advance-001: upper-left square-cornered box, instant page reveals, one two-line wrapped page and one non-Latin (Cyrillic) page the eng OCR model cannot read — the pipeline is expected to abstain on it and commit nothing (docs/spec/05 'abstain, never fabricate'). The three real lines are the clip's invented sentences; the rest are invented distractors so ranking a page is a real decision. No real game text.

messages.original_text: You paid the ferryman. The crossing is done now.
This is not a toll. This is a habit.
Вода помнит то, что люди прячут.
You paid the ferryman at the first crossing.
The habit is older than the toll, and the toll is older than the ferry.
A second ferry appears when the first one is forgotten.
The water keeps what people throw to it.
Coins do not cross. Only people cross.
